title: CDR for CPEng & RPEng Accreditation
description: Support with the competency report needed for chartered engineer accreditation: CPEng with Engineers Australia and RPEng with APEA.

data.sub: Chartered status for independent engineering practice.

items.title: CPEng
items.text: Chartered Professional Engineer, awarded by Engineers Australia.

items.title: RPEng
items.text: Registered Professional Engineer, credentialed by APEA.

data.heading: Why It Matters
paragraphs: Chartered status shows that your competence has been independently assessed. It supports independent practice and professional recognition.
bullets: Evidence of your own engineering work

items.q: Is the report for chartered status the same as a migration CDR?
items.a: The format and purpose can differ by authority and pathway. We prepare the report for the specific assessment you are applying for.
